title: Wireless Communication I
modules: Small Scale Fading: Racian, Rayleigh And Nakagami
Small Scale Fading: Threshold Crossing Rate, Fade
Digital Baseband And Pulse Shaping Modulation
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term used to describe telecommunications in which electromagnetic waves (rather than some form of wire) carry the signal over part or the entire communication path."
Wireless is a term used to describe telecommunications in which electromagnetic waves (rather than some form of wire) carry the signal over part or the entire communication path.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a modulation technique by which digital data is represented by changes in the frequency (pitch) of an audio tone, yielding an encoded signal suitable for transmission via radio or telephone."
AFSK is a modulation technique by which digital data is represented by changes in the frequency (pitch) of an audio tone, yielding an encoded signal suitable for transmission via radio or telephone.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a computer network that covers a broad area (i.e., any network whose communications links cross metropolitan, regional, or national boundaries)."
Wide Area Network (WAN) is a computer network that covers a broad area (i.e., any network whose communications links cross metropolitan, regional, or national boundaries).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the effect that the received signal power fluctuates due to objects obstructing the propagation path between transmitter and receiver."
Shadowing is the effect that the received signal power fluctuates due to objects obstructing the propagation path between transmitter and receiver.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a network that connects two or more local area networks or campus area networks together but does not extend beyond the boundaries of the immediate town/city."
A Metropolitan Area Network (MAN) is a network that connects two or more local area networks or campus area networks together but does not extend beyond the boundaries of the immediate town/city.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the heart of the cellular mobile system."
The MTSO is the heart of the cellular mobile system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are referred to as random access and variants of random access."
Access methods that incur collision are referred to as random access and variants of random access.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of extracting the baseband message from the carrier so that it may be processed and interpreted by the intended receiver (also called sink)."
Demodulation is the process of extracting the baseband message from the carrier so that it may be processed and interpreted by the intended receiver (also called sink).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sinusoidal signal whose frequency increases or decreases over a certain amount of time. iii."
A chirp is a sinusoidal signal whose frequency increases or decreases over a certain amount of time. iii.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rapid variation of signal levels when the user terminal moves short distances."
Fast fading is the rapid variation of signal levels when the user terminal moves short distances.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a spread spectrum multiple access method."
CDMA is a spread spectrum multiple access method.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special case of Double-sideband reduced carrier transmission."
DSB-SC transmission is a special case of Double-sideband reduced carrier transmission.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the difference in travel time between multipath arrivals."
The time delay is the difference in travel time between multipath arrivals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to modulate a higher frequency carrier wave so that it may be transmitted via radio."
Baseband signal is used to modulate a higher frequency carrier wave so that it may be transmitted via radio.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a continuous assessment component of your course."
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to transfer signals to and from the cell phone."
Radio waves are used to transfer signals to and from the cell phone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the modulated signal and the baseband signal is called the modulating signal."
The bandpass signal is called the modulated signal and the baseband signal is called the modulating signal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in HIPERLAN/2 broadband radio access network, IEEE 802.16a WiMax , Bluetooth , etc. ii."
Dynamic TDMA is used in HIPERLAN/2 broadband radio access network, IEEE 802.16a WiMax , Bluetooth , etc. ii.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rough calculation of all known elements of the link to determine if the signal will have the proper strength when it reaches the other end of the link."
A link budget is a rough calculation of all known elements of the link to determine if the signal will have the proper strength when it reaches the other end of the link.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a control mechanism which gives authority to the system to communicate or use the resources of that network."
The token is a control mechanism which gives authority to the system to communicate or use the resources of that network.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for telecommunication signaling over analog telephone lines in the voice-frequency band between telephone handsets and other communications devices and the switching center."
DTMF signaling is used for telecommunication signaling over analog telephone lines in the voice-frequency band between telephone handsets and other communications devices and the switching center.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to connect LANs and other types of networks together, so that users and computers in one location can communicate with users and computers in other locations."
WANs are used to connect LANs and other types of networks together, so that users and computers in one location can communicate with users and computers in other locations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a class of analog modulation."
Angle Modulation is a class of analog modulation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a digital modulation scheme that conveys data by changing, or modulating, the phase of a reference signal (the carrier wave)."
PSK is a digital modulation scheme that conveys data by changing, or modulating, the phase of a reference signal (the carrier wave).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the special case of PDM where all the pulses corresponding to one sample are contiguous in the digital signal."
Pulse- width modulation (PWM) is the special case of PDM where all the pulses corresponding to one sample are contiguous in the digital signal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the transfer of information over a distance without the use of electrical conductors or "wires"."
Wireless communication is the transfer of information over a distance without the use of electrical conductors or "wires".
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a communication channel that experiences fading."
A fading channel is a communication channel that experiences fading.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a portable telephone which receives or makes calls through a cell site (base station), or transmitting tower."
A mobile phone is a portable telephone which receives or makes calls through a cell site (base station), or transmitting tower.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the mechanisms causing attenuation between the transmitter power amplifier and receiver front end."
Path loss is one of the mechanisms causing attenuation between the transmitter power amplifier and receiver front end.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a radio network made up of a number of radio cell (or just cells) each served by at least one fixed-location transceiver known as a cell site or base station."
A cellular system is a radio network made up of a number of radio cell (or just cells) each served by at least one fixed-location transceiver known as a cell site or base station.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a computer network organised around an individual person."
Personal Area Network (PAN) is a computer network organised around an individual person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method for modulation of data commonly used in wireless modems."
CPM is a method for modulation of data commonly used in wireless modems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the medium between the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna."
Channel model is the medium between the transmitting antenna and the receiving antenna.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplest form of amplitude-shift keying (ASK) modulation that represents digital data as the presence or absence of a carrier wave."
OOK is the simplest form of amplitude-shift keying (ASK) modulation that represents digital data as the presence or absence of a carrier wave.
fib: ______ is a technique of reusing frequencies and channels within a communications system to improve capacity and spectral efficiency.
Frequency reuse
Frequency reuse is a technique of reusing frequencies and channels within a communications system to improve capacity and spectral efficiency.
______ is a statistical model for the effect of a propagation environment on a radio signal.
Rayleigh fading
Rayleigh fading is a statistical model for the effect of a propagation environment on a radio signal.
______ is the smallest, least gain practical antenna that can be made.
dipole antenna
A dipole antenna is the smallest, least gain practical antenna that can be made.
______ is a powerful communication receiver technique that provides wireless link improvement at relatively low cost.
Diversity
Diversity is a powerful communication receiver technique that provides wireless link improvement at relatively low cost.
______ is a form of modulation that represents information as variations in the instantaneous phase of a carrier wave.
Phase modulation
Phase modulation is a form of modulation that represents information as variations in the instantaneous phase of a carrier wave.
______ is a commonly-used variation of frequency-shift keying (FSK), which is itself a special case of analog frequency modulation.
CPFSK
CPFSK is a commonly-used variation of frequency-shift keying (FSK), which is itself a special case of analog frequency modulation.
______ is a packet-based TDMA concept where the users contend for the time slots.
Packet Reservation Multiple Access (PRMA)
Packet Reservation Multiple Access
PRMA
Packet Reservation Multiple Access (PRMA) is a packet-based TDMA concept where the users contend for the time slots.
______ is a signal encoder that uses the baseline of PCM but adds some functionality based on the prediction of the samples of the signal.
Differential pulse-code modulation (DPCM)
Differential pulse-code modulation
DPCM
Differential pulse-code modulation (DPCM) is a signal encoder that uses the baseline of PCM but adds some functionality based on the prediction of the samples of the signal.
______ is the closest approximation to a circle among these three and has been used traditionally for system design.
hexagonal cell
The hexagonal cell is the closest approximation to a circle among these three and has been used traditionally for system design.
______ refers to the medium used to convey information from a sender (or transmitter) to a receiver.
Channel
Channel refers to the medium used to convey information from a sender (or transmitter) to a receiver.
______ is a waste from the transmission point of view because it does not carry any information or message.
large carrier power Pc
The large carrier power Pc is a waste from the transmission point of view because it does not carry any information or message.
______ is the process of changing the waveform of transmitted pulses.
Pulse shaping
Pulse shaping is the process of changing the waveform of transmitted pulses.
______ is a variant of DPCM (differential pulse-code modulation) that varies the size of the quantization step, to allow further reduction of the required bandwidth for a given signal-to-noise ratio.
Adaptive DPCM (ADPCM)
Adaptive DPCM
ADPCM

Adaptive DPCM (ADPCM) is a variant of DPCM (differential pulse-code modulation) that varies the size of the quantization step, to allow further reduction of the required bandwidth for a given signal-to-noise ratio.
______ is the least complicated modulation method capable of transmitting speech or music by varying the carrier signal's instantaneous power.
Amplitude modulation
Amplitude modulation is the least complicated modulation method capable of transmitting speech or music by varying the carrier signal's instantaneous power.
______ is a computer network covering a small physical area, like a home, office, or small group of buildings, such as a school, or an airport.
Local Area Network (LAN)
Local Area Network
LAN
Local Area Network (LAN) is a computer network covering a small physical area, like a home, office, or small group of buildings, such as a school, or an airport.
______ is the technology and practice that enables the transmission and reception of information carried by long-wave electromagnetic radiation.
Radio
Radio is the technology and practice that enables the transmission and reception of information carried by long-wave electromagnetic radiation.
______ is a frequency modulation scheme in which digital information is transmitted through discrete frequency changes of a carrier wave.
FSK
FSK is a frequency modulation scheme in which digital information is transmitted through discrete frequency changes of a carrier wave.
______ is used for voice communications in commercial and amateur radio settings.
narrow band form
A narrow band form is used for voice communications in commercial and amateur radio settings.
______ is an analog transmission technique that is inherently narrowband.
FDMA
FDMA is an analog transmission technique that is inherently narrowband.
______ is the major limiting factor in the performance of the cellular radio systems.
Interference
Interference is the major limiting factor in the performance of the cellular radio systems.
______ is a variation of frequency-shift keying (FSK) that uses more than two frequencies.
MFSK
MFSK is a variation of frequency-shift keying (FSK) that uses more than two frequencies.
______ is a form of modulation that represents digital data as variations in the amplitude of a carrier wave.
ASK
ASK is a form of modulation that represents digital data as variations in the amplitude of a carrier wave.
______ is a system composed of two connected parties or devices that can communicate with one another in both directions.
duplex communication system
A duplex communication system is a system composed of two connected parties or devices that can communicate with one another in both directions.
______ is a measure of the minimum time required for the magnitude change of the channel to become decorrelated from its previous value.
coherence time
The coherence time is a measure of the minimum time required for the magnitude change of the channel to become decorrelated from its previous value.
______ is a combination of PSK and ASK: It makes use of polar coordinates, r (amplitude) and Θ (phase).
Polar modulation like QAM
Polar modulation like QAM is a combination of PSK and ASK: It makes use of polar coordinates, r (amplitude) and Θ (phase).
______ is called the 'shape factor' of the Nakagami or the gamma distribution.
parameter m
The parameter m is called the 'shape factor' of the Nakagami or the gamma distribution.
______ is a signal transmission situation in which two or more users wish to simultaneously communicate with each other using the same propagation channel.
Multiple Access
Multiple Access is a signal transmission situation in which two or more users wish to simultaneously communicate with each other using the same propagation channel.
______ is a measure of the approximate bandwidth within which the channel can be assumed to be nearly constant.
Coherence bandwidth
Coherence bandwidth is a measure of the approximate bandwidth within which the channel can be assumed to be nearly constant.
______ is used to improve CSMA performance by terminating transmission as soon as a collision is detected, and reducing the probability of a second collision on retry.
Collision detection
Collision detection is used to improve CSMA performance by terminating transmission as soon as a collision is detected, and reducing the probability of a second collision on retry.
______ is a multiple access method for wireless transmission which allows uncoordinated users to share a common transmission resource.
Reservation ALOHA (R-ALOHA)
Reservation ALOHA
Reservation ALOHA (R-ALOHA) is a multiple access method for wireless transmission which allows uncoordinated users to share a common transmission resource.
______ is the process of encoding information from a message source into manner suitable for transmission.
Modulation
Modulation is the process of encoding information from a message source into manner suitable for transmission.
______ is a modification of pure Carrier Sense Multiple Access (CSMA).
CSMA/CD
CSMA/CD is a modification of pure Carrier Sense Multiple Access (CSMA).
______ is a spread spectrum technique in which the carrier is turned on and off by the pseudorandom code sequence.
Time hopping technique
Time hopping technique is a spread spectrum technique in which the carrier is turned on and off by the pseudorandom code sequence.
